name: Bongani Adams
headline: Junior Mine Planning Engineer | Resource Estimation | Mine Design | Geostatistics | South African Mining Environment
summary: Junior Mine Planning Engineer with 2 years of hands-on experience in mine design, resource estimation, and 3D modeling. Proven ability to deliver accurate, cost-effective mine plans using industry-standard tools. Strong foundation in geostatistics and sustainable mining practices. Based in Johannesburg, South Africa.

Used GOCAD to create a block model for a chromite deposit, achieving 95% consistency with drill data across 120 drill holes.
Collaborated with geologists to validate resource boundaries using Surfer and QGIS, reducing estimation errors by 22%.
Generated haul road and access routes in AutoCAD, reducing vehicle travel time by 14% in a 15km mine site.
Prepared mine plan updates monthly for a gold operation, reducing planning cycle time from 30 to 18 days using MineSight templates.
Conducted a mine plan review for a new underground operation, identifying 3 design flaws that reduced risk exposure by 30%.
